name: Task loader and scorer
role: Pin data and enforce official pair-fraction plus strict all-pairs diagnostics
input_format: Official task JSON and at most two answer grids per test pair
output_format: Task and dataset score records
replaceable_by: Official scorer or audited equivalent
notes: Infrastructure only; current implementation verified by Phase-0 smoke

name: Full multi-view parser
role: Maintain alternative pixel; object; relation; line; frame; motif; panel and symmetry hypotheses
input_format: Demonstrations and test grids
output_format: ParseHypothesis beam
replaceable_by: Single segmentation; pixel-only; external parser
notes: Umbrella component includes connected objects plus lines; corners; frames; motifs; panels and symmetry; M02a alone is not completion of M02

name: Connected-component parse bundle
role: Enumerate low-cost alternative background; connectivity and color-mode object views with provenance
input_format: Validated demonstration and query-input grids
output_format: Immutable connected objects; holes; bounding boxes and sparse touching or containment relations
replaceable_by: One fixed background/connectivity segmentation; pixel-only view
notes: E01a subset only: enumerate no-background and observed-color hypotheses with 4/8 connectivity and single/multicolor components; excludes lines; corners; frames; motifs; panels and symmetry

name: Separator and panel parse bundle
role: Enumerate independent full-span separator and panel-lattice hypotheses without changing M02a identities
input_format: Validated demonstration and query-input grids
output_format: Versioned separator bands; indexed ragged panel views; parse sidecar
replaceable_by: No panel view; task-specific split; external parser
notes: afts-full-span-panels/v0.1; verified on generator-known controls and the fixed development smoke; preserves byte-identical public M02a parses; its 92e50de0 lattice is consumed by the separately verified M05e action

name: Axis-ray rectangle-contact relation sidecar
role: Record external singleton-to-solid-rectangle row/column rays without changing M02a or M02b identities
input_format: Blind grids plus the fixed 4-connected single-color M02a view
output_format: Content-addressed marker/anchor IDs; direction; gap; clear-ray and projected-boundary diagnostics
replaceable_by: Task-specific ray macro; rewriting M02a relations; generic scene graph
notes: afts-axis-aligned-bbox-contact/v0.1 is verified in results/e01a_bbox_contact_v1; the additive sidecar replays exactly while public M02a/M02b bytes remain frozen; only 1f642eb9 is added and arbitrary relations remain outside scope

name: Shape proposer
role: Generate output dimension hypotheses
input_format: Task and parse features
output_format: Ranked shape candidates
replaceable_by: Oracle shape; separate learned model; rule enumeration
notes: Umbrella component remains incomplete; M03a verifies direct axis-integer multiplication only and excludes constants; reductions; transposed ratios; crop-derived sizes and feature formulas

name: Axis-integer shape proposer
role: Infer one consistent positive integer output/input ratio from all demonstrations and project it onto query-input dimensions
input_format: BlindTask demonstrations plus query inputs only
output_format: Content-addressed input-basis factor and bounded query-shape proposals
replaceable_by: No explicit shape proposal; exhaustive factor enumeration; learned shape model
notes: afts-output-shape/v0.1; records identity but emits scale/tile options only for non-identity ratios; query outputs are unavailable

name: Masked grid generator
role: Generate diverse categorical output grids
input_format: Task; shape; augmentation; seed
output_format: Grid candidates and uncertainty
replaceable_by: Autoregressive grid model; recursive network; rules
notes: Existing ARChitects precedent; not novel alone

name: Global masked-grid candidate source
role: Generate a frozen full-mask categorical candidate pool before local repair
input_format: Blind task/test pair; up to four M03a shapes; frozen checkpoint; lane seed
output_format: 64 lane rows; replay traces; grid candidates; encoder/decoder/pair cost ledgers or explicit no-shape failure
replaceable_by: Autoregressive grid model; cold-restart Mask-Predict; larger masked model
notes: Pre-implementation contract: notes/design/m04a-global-masked-grid-contract.md; Grid-CMLM and 12-step 64-lane sampler are pre-registered; no implementation, checkpoint, candidate pool, or result exists

name: Typed DSL
role: Represent executable compositional rules
input_format: Parsed states; typed values and bindings
output_format: Typed AST programs
replaceable_by: Alternative ARC DSL or Python
notes: v0.6 adds the M02c-bound paint_bbox_contacts action after v0.5 periodic broadcast; the fixed post-hoc smoke reaches 40% strict/task-first coverage; this is not holdout generalization

name: Axis scale and tile operations
role: Realize direct positive integer output/input ratios as pixel repetition or whole-grid repetition
input_format: Grid plus bounded positive row/column factors
output_format: Scaled or tiled grid; explicit size invalid
replaceable_by: Explicit canvas constructor; library resize/tile
notes: DSL v0.2 subset paired with M03a; verified under results/e01a_shape_v1

name: Ordered transparent panel overlay
role: Collapse one equal-shape two-axis panel lattice with declared background transparency and row-major priority
input_format: Grid plus one executable M02b panel hypothesis and background
output_format: One panel-sized grid or explicit selection/shape invalid
replaceable_by: Generic alpha compositing; task-specific four-panel macro
notes: DSL v0.3 subset; only a68b268e receives a public proposal; ragged periodic broadcast is excluded

name: Indexed panel-sequence D4 action
role: Apply a D4 group step by relative index from one inferred seed panel and reassemble the original single-axis sequence
input_format: Equal-shape single-axis M02b panel sequence; background; D4 step
output_format: Original-size reassembled grid or explicit selection/shape invalid
replaceable_by: Fixed three-panel rotation macro; arbitrary panel program
notes: afts-panel-sequence-d4/v0.1; verified on atomic and composition controls; only 8e5a5113 receives public M05d proposals and is added at rank 1; 92e50de0 is outside the equal-shape single-axis contract

name: Periodic panel-lattice broadcast
role: Copy one inferred full-size seed to a two-axis congruence class and top-left clip only at bottom/right suffix panels
input_format: Two-axis M02b panel lattice; background; positive row and column periods
output_format: Original-size reassembled grid or explicit selection/shape invalid
replaceable_by: Hard-coded parity fill; explicit destination list; unrestricted stamp renderer
notes: afts-panel-lattice-periodic/v0.1; verified on atomic/composition controls; only 92e50de0 receives a public bound/proposals and is added at rank 1; leading/interior ragged panels and multiple seeds remain invalid

name: BBox contact renderer
role: Paint the first solid-rectangle boundary cell reached by each admitted M02c marker ray while preserving markers and paths
input_format: M02c complete relation hypothesis plus background
output_format: Original-size grid or explicit selection/collision/occlusion/geometry invalid
replaceable_by: Move-until-touching; line drawing; arbitrary destination list; target-specific macro
notes: afts-bbox-contact-render/v0.1 verifies paint_bbox_contacts(background) on six new controls and adds only 1f642eb9 at rank 1; no anchor color; bbox; marker list or destination parameter is exposed

name: Program search
role: Explore typed programs using intermediate execution
input_format: Task; DSL; parse beam; search policy
output_format: Programs; states and execution traces
replaceable_by: Unguided beam; evolutionary search; LLM code
notes: Current fully replayed v0.6 public run keeps 48,177 expansions and 218,637 program executions under the 64-option cap; M02c/M05f separately records 100 structural checks; 216 relation checks; one trial and three demo pre-executions; heterogeneous-source coverage remains deferred to E01b

name: Code hypothesis generator
role: Propose DSL-external programs and candidate macros
input_format: Task representation; tool schema and prompt
output_format: Sandboxed code; output grids; traces
replaceable_by: No LLM; alternate code model; direct grid model
notes: Track model exposure; tokens; API cost and sandbox provenance

name: Candidate IR and store
role: Unify outputs; programs; traces; provenance and cost
input_format: All source records
output_format: Canonical immutable candidates and duplicate groups
replaceable_by: Source-specific stores
notes: Task identifiers are provenance-only and excluded by a feature whitelist

name: Residual compiler
role: Convert deployable verifier counterexamples into typed repair evidence
input_format: Demonstration execution; query-internal consistency; candidate trace
output_format: Separate grid-cell; AST-node and action evidence masks
replaceable_by: Independent source-specific residuals; confidence mask
notes: Candidate novelty is the cross-representation compilation; oracle query residual is prohibited as input

name: Verifier ladder
role: Apply necessary checks and emit soft preference evidence
input_format: Candidate plus demonstrations and deployable invariants
output_format: SAT/UNSAT/UNKNOWN/PARSE_CONFLICT; counterexamples; scores
replaceable_by: Exact-train only; model confidence only
notes: Hard rejection only for necessary conditions until false-negative recall is known

name: Grid repair
role: Re-mask selected output regions
input_format: Grid candidate; deployable residual mask and uncertainty
output_format: Repaired grid candidates
replaceable_by: Cold restart; random mask; Mask-Predict; ReMDM
notes: Novelty depends on residual compiler and controller coupling; not remasking itself

name: Program or trace repair
role: Edit bindings; primitives or typed AST spans
input_format: Program; trace; deployable counterexample; type mask
output_format: Repaired executable candidates
replaceable_by: Full resynthesis; beam continuation; random mutation; tree diffusion
notes: Tree diffusion with execution feedback is prior art

name: Dynamic legality mask
role: Compile conservative action legality from contracts
input_format: Candidate; parse set; four-valued preconditions
output_format: Action-level legal; uncertain; conflict labels plus escape budget
replaceable_by: Fixed mask; no mask; invalid-action masking
notes: Type-directed pruning and action masks are prior art; value is an ARC safety evaluation

name: Next-action controller
role: Allocate online budget and choose the next specialist
input_format: Whitelisted blackboard features; action outcomes and remaining budget
output_format: Distribution over executable next actions
replaceable_by: Static schedule; bandit; hand policy; XGBoost; MLP; DLGN
notes: Novelty is limited to the pre-registered ARC coupling with M09; controller classes are not new

name: Candidate ranker
role: Rank an already frozen candidate pool
input_format: Candidate-level execution and anti-overfit features
output_format: Candidate scores or ordering
replaceable_by: MDL; source confidence; per-source rankers; XGBoost; MLP; DLGN
notes: Separate dataset and experiment from M14

name: Top-2 selector
role: Choose two output grids after ranking and diversity checks
input_format: Verified ranked candidates for one test pair
output_format: At most two answer grids
replaceable_by: Top confidence; majority vote; holistic judge
notes: Separate from legality; ranker and online policy
